positioning: Practical questions for a more considered kitchen.
editorial_note: Front-page choices are editorial selections, not popularity rankings or evidence of product performance.

imagery.alt: Editorial illustration of a green bowl, golden potato wedges, lemon and linen on a sunlit kitchen counter
imagery.caption: AI-generated editorial illustration. Not product photography or a cooking test.
imagery.format_art: Original schematic illustrations, not photographs, brand assets or scale drawings.

cadence.rule: Review one buyer question each Tuesday; publish at most one guide after source, disclosure and link gates pass. New writing stays paused until the production measurement/access gate is cleared. A build refresh is not an article publication.
cadence.monthly: Review authorized Search Console query/page aggregates and Associates report totals monthly. Refresh or choose the next topic from measured reader needs, not assumed popularity.
cadence.demand_status: No query, traffic, conversion or revenue data has been obtained. Seasonal subjects are editorial hypotheses, not verified trends.

decisions.question: Are these the intended products, and do the links attribute to shopnow047c-20?
decisions.known: Five supplied links and a user-selected tracking ID are recorded. Intended ASINs and enrolled-Associates tests remain blank.
decisions.missing: Account approval, intended official listing for each link, confirmation date/source, and one destination/report test per product.
decisions.discover: Use the enrolled Associates workflow to confirm each listing and generate/test its Special Link; check the Tracking ID Summary Report. Do not infer failure from a landing URL without a visible tag.
decisions.recommendation: Keep purchase CTAs gated; retain observed redirects as observations, never intent confirmations.

decisions.question: Where can a real analytics event be received, and what may be retained?
decisions.known: The browser and Python collector now share a tested five-event contract. Production collection is disabled.
decisions.missing: Persistent same-origin host, approved privacy/retention notice, host/proxy log review and a production aggregate receipt.
decisions.discover: Deploy the supported collector behind TLS, review the host logs, and prove one authorized diagnostic receipt before enabling both switches.
decisions.recommendation: Use the aggregate-only self-hosted route. No third-party tracker, fabricated session count or browser conversion pixel.

decisions.question: Which searches actually bring people here?
decisions.known: One canonical publication, a generated sitemap, RSS and question-led editorial clusters exist. No search-performance report has been obtained.
decisions.missing: Verified Search Console property, sitemap submission receipt and dated query/page aggregates.
decisions.discover: Verify the URL-prefix property for the GitHub Pages subpath in an authorized Google account; submit sitemap.xml and review the Performance report when data exists.
decisions.recommendation: Treat the topic queue as hypotheses until measured impressions/clicks justify the next guide. No ranking or traffic promise.

decisions.question: Should meat thermometers join the air-fryer publication?
decisions.known: Two supplied links have observed thermometer listing titles. Their intended models and specifications are unconfirmed.
decisions.missing: Intended models, official model-to-listing evidence and a decision to expand coverage.
decisions.discover: Reconcile the manufacturer model with the intended official listing before adding product reviews or comparisons. Keep the research records separate meanwhile.
decisions.recommendation: Keep air fryers as the editorial focus; expose the thermometer research category without invented specifications.

decisions.question: Who is responsible for the publication, and what experience may it claim?
decisions.known: Zone1 Kitchen is the site identity and its repository owner is public. Content is AI-assisted and documentation-based; no hands-on testing is established.
decisions.missing: A named, consenting human editor and evidence for any claimed expertise or product testing.
decisions.discover: Obtain an authorized byline/profile and a written review responsibility. A person or credential cannot be supplied by inference.
decisions.recommendation: Publish the method and repository contact now; do not invent an expert, test lab or headshot.

decisions.question: What imagery is useful without pretending we tested the products?
decisions.known: The front page uses a labeled AI-generated kitchen still life and original generic format drawings. No product photos have been licensed.
decisions.missing: Rights-cleared model-specific photography or documented original product photography.
decisions.discover: Obtain written brand-media permission or a real, documented photo shoot. Match the photographed SKU before it appears next to a product claim.
decisions.recommendation: Keep editorial art visibly separate from product evidence; use no fabricated product photo or customer testimonial.

decisions.question: When does another guide earn a place in the journal?
decisions.known: Existing guides are filed into reader-intent clusters. A Tuesday review cadence is now documented, not a promise of automatic publication.
decisions.missing: Production measurement/access clearance, a responsible reviewer, and measured query evidence for future topic choices.
decisions.discover: Review one question weekly; require a buyer takeaway, primary citations, link checks and disclosure review before release. Use dated query reports when available.
decisions.recommendation: Improve existing useful guides before generating volume. Every approved article must enter the article register, sitemap and RSS together.

decisions.question: Which research and optimization can run without restricted inputs?
decisions.known: Builds, schema checks, link checks, source coverage and report-validation code can run automatically. Live Amazon research/optimization is not running.
decisions.missing: Authorized API access and permissions for each proposed use, first-party campaign evidence and an approved publishing workflow.
decisions.discover: Review the current API and Agent Terms before connecting a service; separate manufacturer facts and first-party aggregates from restricted Amazon Program Content.
decisions.recommendation: Automate deterministic checks, not unsupported profitability claims. No review scraping, price alerts, model training on Program Content or autonomous spend.
